text:
ryan_oncall: :rotating_light: Pager — GPU pool 'prod-east-1-gpu' at 98% utilization, queue growing for model-v9 variants. Seen sustained token throughput spike ~ 09:12 UTC. Incident bot triggered.
incident-bot: Severity: P1. Alert: gpu_pool_capacity_exhaustion (prod-east-1-gpu). Queue depth 4800 requests, avg wait 32s. Paging @ryan_oncall, @carla_sre.
ryan_oncall: I'm on it. Initial hypothesis: v9 rollout increased context lengths + kv-cache accesses, causing degraded batching efficiency. Any recent rollouts?
deploy-bot: Deploy: model-v9.3 rolled to 40% traffic at 08:50 UTC.
carla_sre: Confirmed. We're seeing per-request max_seq ~ 12k tokens for some customers. KV cache miss rate jumped from 8% -> 54% after hotload.
mohit_eng-runtime: Noted. Runtime metrics: small batches, high tail latency. Kernel selection falling back to slower path due to 12-bit quant profile.
sara_support: We have ~5 enterprise customers reporting 503s, flagged by health pings. Two have active SLAs.
ryan_oncall: Triage plan: 1) Immediate mitigation: throttle non-enterprise free tier to reduce tail load. 2) Auto-scale try fail? Check autoscaler logs. 3) If scale cannot keep up, roll back traffic split for model-v9.3 to 0%.
carla_sre: Autoscaler reports: attempted to spin new nodes, hit quota limit for G4dn in region. Error: "quota_exceeded: no more instances available in quota pool". Also cold starts ~ 45s.
mohit_eng-runtime: Can we enable emergency node eviction/allow bursting to shared spare pool?
ryan_oncall: We'll try burst. Initiating runbook step: `invoke runbook/gpu-burst` now.
carla_sre: Running: `./scripts/evict-low-priority.sh --pool prod-east-1-gpu --target 3`
carla_sre: Evicted low-priority jobs, reclaimed 3 GPUs. Utilization down to 92% but queue still high.
incident-bot: Autoscaler attempted +4 nodes at 09:16 UTC, failed due to quota.
mohit_eng-runtime: Also seeing kv-cache warmup pressure: many warmups concurrently causing IO saturation on the kv-store. Consider limiting concurrent warmups or prioritizing enterprise pin warmups.
sara_support: Notifying impacted customers; drafting status: "Degraded inference performance in US-East. Working on mitigation — some requests may see errors or delays."
lina_prod: Recommend rollback v9.3 canary to avoid further pressure. If rollback, we should instrument a targeted rollback for high-consuming routes only.
ryan_oncall: Agreed. Start rollback to 0% for model-v9.3 now. `deploy rollback --model model-v9.3 --traffic 0 --reason "autoscale failure"`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated. Traffic to model-v9.3 reduced to 0% at 09:21 UTC.
carla_sre: Post-rollback: queue depth dropping, CPU/GPU tail latency improving. KV miss rate decreasing slowly.
mohit_eng-runtime: Applying runtime mitigations: temporarily reduce `max_batch_size` from 64 -> 32 for model-v9-family to improve scheduling, and disable background kv-cache prefetch for non-enterprise routes.
ryan_oncall: Executed batch size change and prefetch toggle.
carla_sre: Also enabled emergency_throttle for anonymous/free tier: `rate_limit: 5rps` for inference endpoints.
sara_support: Sent update to customers at 09:28 UTC. Two enterprise customers acknowledged and accepted temporary degradation.
ryan_oncall: Current status: queue depth 420 -> trending down, avg wait 14s, GPU util 78%. Marking incident as mitigated for immediate customer impact but still in active remediation.
carla_sre: Next steps: 1) Request region quota increase for G4dn immediately (contact cloud support). 2) Investigate why model-v9 rollout increased context-length distribution — check tokenizer differences and client SDK changes. 3) Postmortem and action items: better rollout canary checks for KV miss rate and cold-start cost.
mohit_eng-runtime: Assigning follow-ups: I'll create patch to make KV warmup sequential per model instance, and add a config gate for concurrent warmups.
lina_prod: We'll add traffic guardrail: automated rollback if queue depth > 2000 after rollout window.
ryan_oncall: Thanks all. I'll convert this thread to incident channel and schedule an incident review 48h.
carla_sre: FYI logs from autoscaler and quota errors:```json
{"time":"2026-03-15T09:16:12Z","level":"error","msg":"quota_exceeded","region":"us-east-1","instance_type":"g4dn.xlarge"}
```
sara_support: Saving notes and customer list to the incident doc.
incident-bot: Incident P1 transitioned -> Mitigated at 09:33 UTC by @ryan_oncall. Postmortem required.
ryan_oncall: Leaving a final note: urgent: add canary metric `kv_cache_miss_rate` to rollout dashboards and base automated rollback on it.
carla_sre: Copy that. I'll own the postmortem write-up. :thumbsup:
